title: Plastic Sorting Station for the Elementary School Activity Hall
description: We want to build a cleaner, easier-to-understand sorting station for drink bottles, clean plastic packaging, and mixed waste in the school activity hall. Right now students often want to recycle correctly but the setup is too vague, so recyclable items get tossed into the wrong bin during lunch and after events. Funding will go toward durable labeled bins, rinse reminders, example boards with common items, and a simple visual guide that teachers can use during sustainability lessons.
